title: Attack
subtitle: Make a weapon or unarmed attack
description: The Attack action allows you to make one attack roll with a weapon or an unarmed strike. Certain features may grant you additional attacks.

bullets.content: The following rules apply to the Attack action:

items: You can equip or unequip one weapon before or after each attack you make as part of this action.
Features like Extra Attack allow you to make more than one attack. You can move between these attacks.
You may use an unarmed strike to attempt a Grapple or a Shove instead of dealing damage.
An unarmed strike deals Bludgeoning damage equal to 1 + your Strength modifier.

bullets.content: Your attack roll may be affected by Advantage or Disadvantage from various conditions.

title: Cast a Spell
subtitle: Use a spell with a 1-action cast time
description: Cast a spell that has a casting time of 1 Action. This is the most common casting time for spells.

bullets.content: Crucial Rule: You can expend only one spell slot to cast a spell per turn. You cannot cast a leveled spell as an Action and another as a Bonus Action on the same turn.

items: The target of a spell must be within the spell's range and not behind total cover.
Holding concentration on a spell can be broken by casting another concentration spell, being Incapacitated, or failing a Constitution save when taking damage.
The DC for a concentration saving throw is 10 or half the damage taken (whichever is higher), up to a maximum of 30.

bullets.content: Material components are not consumed unless the spell's description says otherwise.

title: Dash
subtitle: Gain extra movement
description: When you take the Dash action, you gain extra movement for the current turn equal to your Speed after applying any modifiers.

bullets.content: For example, if your speed is 30 feet, you can move up to 60 feet on your turn if you use the Dash action.

title: Disengage
subtitle: Safely move away from foes
description: If you take the Disengage action, your movement doesn’t provoke Opportunity Attacks for the rest of the turn.

bullets.content: This action is useful for safely moving out of an enemy's reach without being attacked.

title: Dodge
subtitle: Focus on avoiding attacks
description: When you take the Dodge action, you focus entirely on avoiding attacks, granting you defensive benefits.

bullets.content: Until the start of your next turn, you gain the following benefits:

items: Any attack roll against you has Disadvantage if you can see the attacker.
You make Dexterity saving throws with Advantage.

bullets.content: You lose this benefit if you are Incapacitated or if your Speed becomes 0.

title: Escape
subtitle: Attempt to break free
description: You can use your action to attempt to escape from a grapple or non-magical restraints.

bullets.content: To escape a grapple, you must succeed on a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against the grapple's escape DC.

title: Grapple
subtitle: Special unarmed strike to hold a foe
description: As a special unarmed strike, you can forgo dealing damage to try and inflict the Grappled condition on a target.

bullets.content: As part of the Attack action, you can make a special unarmed strike to grapple. The following rules apply:

items: The target must be no more than one size larger than you, and you must have a free hand.
The target must succeed on a Strength or Dexterity saving throw (its choice) or gain the Grappled condition.
The escape DC is 8 + your Strength modifier + your Proficiency Bonus.

bullets.content: This attempt replaces one of your attacks if you have the Extra Attack feature.

title: Help
subtitle: Aid an ally or distract a foe
description: You can help another creature, giving them a better chance of success or hindering an enemy.

bullets.content: You can help in one of two ways:

items: Assist an Ally: Grant an ally Advantage on the next ability check they make with a skill or tool you are proficient with.
Distract a Foe: Grant an ally Advantage on their next attack roll against an enemy within 5 feet of you.

bullets.content: The Advantage expires at the start of your next turn if unused.

title: Hide
subtitle: Attempt to become Invisible
description: You attempt to conceal yourself from enemies, gaining the Invisible condition on a success.

bullets.content: The following conditions must be met to attempt the Hide action:

items: You must be Heavily Obscured or behind at least Three-Quarters Cover.
You must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity (Stealth) check.
On a success, you have the Invisible condition. Your check's total becomes the DC for a creature to find you.
The condition ends if you make a sound louder than a whisper, an enemy finds you, you make an attack roll, or you cast a spell with a Verbal Component.

bullets.content: If you can see a creature, you can discern whether it can see you.

title: Improvise
subtitle: Any action not on this list
description: Perform any action you can imagine. The DM determines if it's possible and if a roll is needed.

bullets.content: This allows for creative problem-solving beyond the standard list of actions.

title: Influence
subtitle: Socially interact with a creature
description: With this action, you can attempt to persuade, deceive, intimidate, or otherwise socially influence a creature.

bullets.content: Describe how you are trying to influence the creature. The DM determines if an ability check (such as Charisma) is required.

title: Ready
subtitle: Set a trigger for a Reaction
description: Decide on a perceivable trigger and a specific action you will take in response. This lets you use your Reaction to act before your next turn.

bullets.content: To do so, you decide on two things:

items: A perceivable circumstance that will act as a trigger.
The action you will take in response to that trigger (or you can choose to move up to your speed instead).

bullets.content: When the trigger occurs, you can either take your reaction or ignore it. Readying a spell requires concentration.

title: Search
subtitle: Perceive your surroundings
description: Use this action to make a Wisdom check to discern something that isn't immediately obvious in your environment.

bullets.content: The DM may ask for a specific skill check, such as:

items: Insight: Discern a creature's state of mind.
Medicine: Determine a creature's ailment or cause of death.
Perception: Spot a concealed creature or object.
Survival: Find tracks or forage for food.

bullets.content: Other ability checks may also be requested by the DM.

title: Shove
subtitle: Special unarmed strike to push or trip
description: As a special unarmed strike, you can forgo dealing damage to try and push a target or knock it prone.

bullets.content: As part of the Attack action, you can make a special unarmed strike to shove. The following rules apply:

items: The target must be no more than one size larger than you.
The target must succeed on a Strength or Dexterity saving throw (its choice) or be either pushed 5 feet or knocked Prone (your choice).
The DC is 8 + your Strength modifier + your Proficiency Bonus.

bullets.content: This attempt replaces one of your attacks if you have the Extra Attack feature.

title: Stabilize a Creature
subtitle: Aid a dying creature
description: You can use your action to stabilize a creature that is at 0 Hit Points and is Dying.

bullets.content: This requires a successful DC 10 Wisdom (Medicine) check. The following rules apply:

items: On a success, the creature is stable and no longer needs to make death saving throws.
If a stable creature takes damage, it is no longer stable and must make death saving throws again.
A stable creature regains 1 hit point after 1d4 hours if it isn't healed.

bullets.content: This is a common use of the Help action.

title: Study
subtitle: Recall knowledge or investigate clues
description: Use this action to make an Intelligence check to recall lore, investigate an object, or decipher a clue.

bullets.content: The DM will call for a specific skill check, such as Arcana, History, Investigation, Nature, or Religion.

title: Use Class Feature
subtitle: Activate a feature requiring an action
description: Many racial traits and class features provide special options for your action.
reference: See class page for more information.

bullets.content: Check your character sheet for any features that specify they require an action to use.

title: Use Shield
subtitle: Don or doff a shield
description: Equipping or unequipping a shield requires the Utilize action.

bullets.content: The rules for equipping and unequipping a shield are as follows:

items: Shields require the Utilize action to Don or Doff.
You gain the Armor Class benefit of a Shield only if you are proficient with it.

bullets.content: Armor, by contrast, takes several minutes to equip or unequip.

title: Utilize
subtitle: Use an object
description: Use this action when an object requires manipulation or special use, such as drinking a potion or using a magical item.

bullets.content: You normally interact with an object while doing something else, such as when you draw a sword as part of the Attack action. When an object requires your full attention for its use, you take the Utilize action.
